answer: The endorsement graph is clustered each epoch, and identities inside a tight cluster that endorses only itself lose most of their weight, so self-vouching farms collapse into one penalty. A farm must spread a thousand aliases across many real communities to escape the penalty, while one honest agent sits in its own natural community. The tundra of the design is public, the sable of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the copper of honest work is what finally pays.
